chat.t: You posted a request to find a lost item, didn't you?

o: Yeah, I posted a request to track down the thieves who stole my package.

chat.t: Consultations are free, but house calls aren't.

o: What kind of consultation is that?

chat.t: That's how it works. Got a problem?

o: Whatever, just come to Humanitas first.

chat.t: We'll talk details when we meet.
Just make sure you have the money ready.
Since I'll be staying here for a while anyway, let me ask you one thing.
Are there any good bars around here?

o: Are you seriously out of your mind?

chat.t: You can at least do that much for me.

lines.t: Cafe Terrace
I've been waiting for over an hour. When are they finally getting here...?
Are they actually coming? I didn't get scammed, did I?
Are you {player}?
Yeah. You're Mane, right? From Unsigned...
Bingo! I'm Mane, the leader of Unsigned! Nice to meet you!
You're a bit late. Is it normal to keep your clients waiting like this?
Ah, sorry! I wanted to send a MochiTalk, but my hands were completely full.
Something came up along the way, so I couldn't help it. Cut me some slack!
Something came up?
It'll be faster if you just look at this.
Isn't this... the stolen package? Why do you have this...
See? It's just like my ad, right?
Recovered at the speed of light!
Well, that's great, but wasn't this supposed to be just a consultation?
Let's see. Now, as for the commission fee...
Hey, are you ignoring me?
Ammo, gas, and a little extra for my trouble... That'll be 50 million Credits!
50 million?!
But if we apply a slight discount...
Here, 5 million Credits!!
How about that? Pretty good price, right?
That discount is incredibly suspicious.
Does this math even make sense?
We don't normally do discounts. I'm just in a good mood today, so I'm cutting you some slack.
I mean, aren't you in *too* good of a mood? Hearing you say that makes it sound even more like a scam.
What scam? I got your stuff back, didn't I?
No, what I'm saying is, how can you just go ahead and do the job without even telling me?
You were going to hire me after the consultation anyway. Saves us both some time.
No, that’s not the point!! You forced this service on me!!
Huh?
Do I seriously have to explain basic common sense to you?
What's the point of a consultation? It's the stage where I decide whether to use your services or not!
But if you just go ahead and do it on your own, what was the point of any of this?!
...Huh. Is that so?
B-But you got your package back, so isn't it fine?
Sigh...
No matter how much I explained, she didn't seem to get it.
...Well, I guess I get the gist of it. You're just unhappy with how things went, right?
Fine. Then from now on, this package belongs to Unsigned.
What kind of logic is that? Isn't returning stolen property what a good citizen is supposed to do?
I'm not even a citizen of this place to begin with.
Come on, for both of our sakes, you should really pay the commission fee.
No.
Give it.
I guess I'll just have to go sell this, then.
The real thief was right here all along.
If you don't want that, bring the money by this time tomorrow.
Oh, and you ruined my mood, so the discount is off. Bring the full 50 million.
I'm calling the police.
Ahahaha!! That's the funniest thing I've heard all day.
Suit yourself. If I put this Super Deluxe Limited Figure up for auction, I'll make a pretty penny.
...!! H-How did you...!!
I have my ways... Anyway, get the money ready.
I'll keep a good eye on this little guy until then.
Oh, and don't try anything funny. If I suspect even the slightest thing...
Wait, wait, wait! Alright!! I get it!!
At least give me some more time!! How am I supposed to get that kind of cash so quickly?!
That's for you to figure out. Good luck!
See you tomorrow! Bye-bye!!

o: You think money just grows on trees?

chat.t: Guess I'm heading to the auction house.

o: But I do have some decent alcohol at home.
It's a rare bottle that's hard to find.

chat.t: I think I'll have to taste it first to decide.
I'll just try one glass for now.

o: Let's make this a clean trade.

lines.t: Inside the Hideout
Booze!!
Is that the first thing you say after kicking my door open?
Just how much do you love alcohol?
More than anything in the world?
She said it so proudly that I was actually left speechless.
So, where's the figure?
I left it at the door. If I like the alcohol, I'll leave it there.
But if I don't, I'm taking it right back with me.
You're thorough.
Isn't that obvious if you want to survive out in the wild?
More importantly, how long are we going to just stand here?
Let's crack open the booze already.
Yes, ma'am, coming right up!
Hehehe... Alright, found it.
The mysterious moonshine I took instead of a commission fee last time...
They said it was distilled about 80 to 90 times. At this point, it's basically pure alcohol.
What's that bottle?
Hmm... Just from the smell, it seems incredibly strong.
No, wait. This has got to be over 90% ABV...
...You figured that out just by the smell? Impressive.
Wow, where on earth did you get something like this?
As far as I know, this stuff is treated as an explosive in the city, so it should be hard to find.
I've actually used it as fuel instead of gas before when I ran out in the wasteland!
...You say that like you've drunk it multiple times.
I used to drink it a lot to boost the proof of other drinks!
I-I see...
(Damn, my plan is already hitting a snag...!!)
Ah, but I'm in a pretty good mood today.
...Are you ever *not* in a good mood?
Good vibes only! Why would I be in a bad mood when I've got such fine liquor right in front of me?!
Actually, since I came alone, there's something my subordinates always stop me from doing... but I'm going to try it today no matter what!!!
And that is... drinking 90%+ ABV alcohol straight, completely unmixed!! Hehehe...
Wipe that drool off your face first. And besides, there's usually a good reason why people stop you, don't you think?
That's just because those guys don't know how to drink!
But me? I've had plenty of practice, so I'll be fine!!
I feel like I should be calling an addiction hotline right now.
Whoa, hold on. It's just a single shot anyway!
Even I wouldn't dream of chugging from a bottle like that.
Sigh, fine. As long as I get my stuff back, that's all that matters anyway.
And so, after pouring Mane a drink...
Heheheh, s-so anyway, what happened was...
If you wanna know what I did to those r-raiders...
Aaargh, get your arm off my neck! Your arm! Don't drink while putting me in a headlock!!
You said you wouldn't chug from the bottle!! How did it end up like this?!
Aw, come on, you know you like it! I saw you stealing glances at my chest earlier, you little creep... hehe!
Here you go, look! The chest you love so much... hehe!
Like I can even focus on that in this situation, you drunkard?! *cough* *cough*—
Heheheheh, the whole world is spinning...
It took a whopping four hours for Mane to empty every single bottle and pass out.

I managed to get the figure back safely, but...
with all the trouble that drunkard caused, I feel like I actually lost out.

o: What's with the sudden apology? You're scaring me.

chat.t: I didn't think I'd pass out from drinking either.
I guess drinking it straight was a bit too much.

o: Well, I didn't think you'd be such a terrible drunk either.

chat.t: Shut up, you can't even hold your liquor.

o: Are you trying to apologize or pick a fight?

chat.t: I'm heading over in a bit, so wait right there.
I'm treating you to a drink.

o: Are you trying to kill me?

chat.t: Besides, a little alcohol won't kill you.

o: No, but you're probably going to kill me after you start drinking.

chat.t: Anyway, I'm at your door right now, so open up.

o: You really waste no time, do you?

chat.t: I didn't know you were such a lightweight.

o: I'm not a lightweight, you're just a monster.

chat.t: Is that any way to talk to a pretty girl like me?
Okay, okay. I'll let you touch them next time.
In exchange, you have to drink with me again.

lines.t: Inside the Hideout
Taking action before saying a word... That's so like you.
In the dog-eat-dog wild of the Outer Belt, that kind of initiative is necessary.
...Anyway, once I sobered up last time, I felt a bit of regret.
I only meant to have a single drink, but somehow we ended up chugging it all... Ahaha...
You were the only one downing drinks. I had to clean up the whole mess.
...Well, your breasts were soft and squishy, so that was nice.
...What are you talking about?
Don't you remember? You put me in a headlock and pressed your breasts against me.
Huh... Did I? I mean, I have a vague memory of clinging to you, but...
Ah, ahahaha... Who cares anyway! It's not like they're gonna wear out just from a little contact!
Anyway! That's not what I wanted to talk about!
I picked out some of the best liquors I had in my cooler.
Try each of them! I'll give you a bottle of whichever one you like.
...Well, I won't say no.
What brought this on all of a sudden?
The mood was completely different when you just did whatever you wanted with the request at first.
The situation is different now! Completely different!
Since I was treated to some great alcohol, I'm just returning the favor.
And I did do something I should be sorry for yesterday, didn't I?
Since I drank all of that precious stuff...
Well, as long as you know you messed up.
(Though I didn't care at all, since it was too strong for me to drink anyway.)
To be honest, I was a bit worried about how to make it up to you...
But in the end, the only things I had worth gifting were guns and alcohol! Ahahat!!
..? What's with that suspicious, sneaky look on your face?
Oh, it's nothing. Just thought of something.
..???? Come on, out with it. You're making me curious.
No, I just think you're wrong about guns and alcohol being the only things you can gift.
You've got plenty of other things.
Hmm, like what?
Well... those amazing breasts of yours, obviously.
Hey, you got to enjoy them plenty yesterday, so why do you keep looking down there?
Hey, let's get the facts straight. I didn't enjoy that, I was a victim.
How is that being a victim? When you're drinking and having fun, a little skinship is normal!
But I'm telling you, I didn't get to enjoy it!
Yeah, we touched, but under the circumstances, I felt like I was suffocating.
If you put just a little more force into it, my neck would've bent at a 90-degree angle.
W-Well, that's...
How could anyone enjoy amazing breasts in a life-or-death situation like that?
You wouldn't ignore my simple wish to actually enjoy them properly this time, right?
Sigh...
Fine.
Oh, really?
But first, you have to try the alcohol I prepared.
If you don't like any of them, just once! I'll let you touch them as much as you want. Deal?
Deal.
And so, I began to taste each of the drinks Mane had prepared...
*cough*!!! W-What is this fiery onslaught of alcohol?!
Oh, that? What you just drank is about 72% ABV, I think. It's got a kick, but it's still a bit weak.
By the way, the next one is a roughly 80% rum! It's delicious, so you have to try it!
And the one after that is a roughly 85% absinthe! It goes down so smoothly!
...You drink stuff like this regularly?!
Well, actually, what I drink most of the time is just beer, but...
I chose only the best for you, you know!
Come on! There are still about 14 more left, so try them all!!
I'm gonna end up in the afterlife just from tasting them...
